visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven final portable frames and the two original Qualla photographs, plus the supplementary floor plan and miniature layout. Crossed rounded concrete terraces, revised forward upper bedroom volume, open pergola, layered stone core, red glazing and hanging stream stair retain the individual house form. Connected stepped rock ledges replaced the rejected isolated polygon boulders. The house underside and cascade are visible on preserved terrain. Rock shapes and water remain a coarse static interpretation, not photoreal geology.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven final shared views, including the north-up map overlay. Main house, curved link and L-shaped guest wing follow the three mapped envelopes. Concrete, sandstone and painted-metal graphs use metric UVs; glazing is portable. This fixture uses flat test terrain: it deliberately hides below-zero stream geometry and leaves the elevated guest wing unsupported. It validates materials, transform, reference-point sampling and unload only; actual ground fit is reviewed separately in the preserved-relief scene.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen final medium-fi views across lights, quality modes, distances, silhouette and four forced levels. The upper room was extended after the first review showed an excessively empty terrace. Cantilevers, offset core, connection and guest wing persist across levels. The 128 m research terrain patch ends above the synthetic floor, so its distant edge/shadow is a fixture boundary, not model geometry. Near views demonstrate the guest foundation entering the hill and clear space below the main terraces. No device frame-rate claim.

fidelityReview.scope: Main Fallingwater house, uphill guest wing and covered link, with short interpreted rock/stream context; interiors and surrounding forest excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Accepted medium-fi exterior of the main cantilevered house and uphill guest wing. Two inspected Qualla originals control concrete bands, stratified masonry, red glazing, underside beams and stream stair. The local floor plan and miniature are secondary layout evidence; conflicting hero attribution was excluded. Exact geological outcrops, water level, hidden room boundaries, guest-wing openings and repair details are simplified. Forest and interior furnishings are omitted; reference images are not embedded or redistributed.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current hash-bound levels pass strict budgets and were inspected: skyline 758, district 3860, street 8096 and closeup 8096 triangles. Authored low levels retain the crossed terraces and guest connection; street uses the same geometry as closeup with a smaller runtime encoding. Declared error budgets are authoring limits, not independently measured distances.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact source regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source, scene and terrain schemas pass. Terrain PNG encoding error is bounded by its 37 m quantization range and recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run is claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi exterior based on two inspected Qualla originals, supplementary local layout images and generalized main-house/covered-walk/guest-wing map controls; not a measured architectural survey.

Crossing terrace axes, stone core, red glazing, hanging stair and clear underside are modeled. Exact room plans, hidden facades, guest-wing openings, structural repairs and roof drains are simplified interpretations.

The short static stream, cascade and rock ledges illustrate the house-waterfall relationship. They are not a hydrologic simulation, exact geological reconstruction or current water-level claim. Surrounding terrain is preserved rather than flattened.

Covered connection and guest wing follow mapped outlines at approximate relative elevations. Coarse terrain is not a surveyed floor datum; other host elevation datasets may require new placement review.
No interior furnishings, sculpture replica, surrounding forest or external image textures are included. Local reference photography remains outside runtime packs.
